Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
True stewardship begins with the internal worship of the heart. Dedicate every part of thy being to His glory this day.
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
Surrender thy logic to His providence. Thy walk is directed by a wisdom that transcendeth thy own.
But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
Let the priority of the Kingdom define thy schedule. When thy focus is eternal, thy temporal needs are His concern.
I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
Thy power for consistency is not found in thy will, but in His might. Labour with confidence in thy King.
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
The Word of God is thy sure guide through the darkness of this world. Meditate upon it to illuminate thy next step.
Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen.
In the midst of thy busy disciplines, find the silence where His sovereignty is revealed. Cease thy striving and trust Him.
Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
Ask for a fresh cleansing. Let His holiness penetrate thy secret thoughts and thy most private habits today.
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Rest in the sufficiency of His grace. Thy Shepherd seeth thy every need and provideth for thy soul with abundance.
Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart.
Patient waiting is a fruit of faithfulness. Let thy courage rise while the Master worketh on thy behalf in the secret places.
I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me... bringeth forth much fruit.
Strength floweth from thy connection to the Source. Abide in Him through prayer and study to bear fruit that remaineth.
In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
Include the Lord in every choice, both great and small. He shall lead thee beside the still waters of His will.
For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
Fear is a distraction from thy purpose. Walk in the authority and the sound mind that the Holy Spirit provideth.
The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
When the world assaileth thee, invoke His Name. It is thy sure refuge and thy impenetrable shield against all harm.
Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
Thy load is too heavy for thee, but not for Him. Surrender thy cares and let His strength be thy support today.
Be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ\'s sake hath forgiven you.
Grace must be the measure of thy walk. Extend the same mercy unto others that thou hast received from thy Father.
Communication with thy Creator is thy lifeline. Keep the door of thy heart open to Him through all thy daily labours.
Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
Guard the wellspring of thy spirit. Let only that which is pure and faithful enter thy heart in this hour.
The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
Invest thy time in that which is eternal. The world passeth away, but thy faithfulness to His Word remaineth forever.
Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you.
Take but one step toward thy Father, and thou shalt find Him rushing to meet thee in love and restorative grace.
For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
Examine thy priorities. Let thy heart be anchored in the treasures of His Kingdom rather than the temporal things of earth.
And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men.
Work as an offering to thy King. Excellence in thy duties is a fragrant fruit of thy devotion to Him.
If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God... and it shall be given him.
Divine direction is but a prayer away. Seek His counsel before thou undertakest thy work this day.
The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
Thou hast a Fortress that no enemy can breach. Trust in His goodness through every trial and every storm.
I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith.
Persevere toward the mark. Thy daily consistency is the building of a legacy that shall endure for all eternity.
But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles.
Patience is a holy discipline. In thy quiet waiting, He is preparing thee for higher flights and greater service.
He must increase, but I must decrease.
Let thy self fade into the background. Let the glory of thy King be the central theme of thy life today.
Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
Purity of motive granteth thee spiritual vision. Ask the Lord to cleanse thy heart and clarify thy holy purpose.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
True rest is found only at His feet. Cease thy striving and find thy Sabbath in His presence this very hour.
The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
Cease thy striving. The battle is not thine, but the Lord\'s. Trust in His sovereign hand to deliver thee today.
Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
Hand over thy plans to Him this morning. He shall direct thy paths and steady thy mind through all thy duties.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith.
The Holy Spirit worketh within thee to produce a rich harvest. Cultivate these virtues through thy daily disciplines.
Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true... think on these things.
Steward thy thoughts with care. Fill thy mind with that which is virtuous, pure, and praiseworthy today.
He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much.
Do not despise small beginnings or minor tasks. Thy faithfulness in the little things prepareth thee for greater service.
Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season.
Be ready to share thy hope at all times. Thy life and thy words may be the only Gospel some will ever read.
The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee.
Receive the priestly blessing. Let the light of His countenance be thy constant joy through all thy labours today.
Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
Vigilance is the price of spiritual growth. Stand firm in thy convictions and be strong in thy commitments.
Be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
Faith without action is but a shadow. Turn the Truth thou knowest into the habits thou livest every day.
Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses... let us run with patience.
Thou art part of a grander history. Run thy spiritual race today with endurance and a fixed purpose.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.
Reverence for thy Creator is the first step toward true discipline. Seek His holiness above all earthly understanding.
Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed.
Diligent study of the Word is a divine labour. Handle the Truth with precision, honour, and care.
But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet... pray to thy Father which is in secret.
Seek the intimacy of the secret place. Thy Father seeth thy hidden devotion and shall reward thee openly.
Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly.
Guard thy influences with jealousy. Walk in the light of the Word, separate from the follies of the world.
Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart.
Waiting is a holy discipline. Let thy courage rise while the Master worketh on thy behalf in the secret places.
In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
Gratitude is a spiritual duty. Find three things to thank the Master for, even in the midst of thy trials today.
Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father.
Thy life is thy message. Let thy conduct today be a radiant reflection of the Master\'s love and grace.
Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight.
Watch thy speech and thy hidden thoughts. Let them be a sweet savour unto thy God through all thy labours.
He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
Art thou at thy wit\'s end? This is where His glory beginneth. Receive His divine energy for thy spiritual disciplines.
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
Fix thy gaze upon Jesus. A mind anchored in Him is immune to the storms of anxiety and doubt.
For with God nothing shall be impossible.
Remove \'impossible\' from thy vocabulary. With thy God, every mountain can be moved by the power of faith.
Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
Be persistent in thy petitions. Thy Father delighteth to open the windows of heaven for the earnest and seeking heart.
If ye love me, keep my commandments.
Obedience is the highest form of worship. Let thy love for Him be seen in thy faithfulness today.
And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body.
Let His peace be the umpire of thy soul. If peace be absent, seek His face until it returneth to guide thee.
But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
Never settle for thy current stature. Press on to know Him more deeply with each passing hour of thy life.
The Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
He is thy Guardian. Trust His faithfulness to steady thy feet and shield thee from the enemy\'s snares today.
For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
Remember the price that was paid. Celebrate the free gift of life thou hast received through His sacrifice.
Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free.
Return not to the chains of thy past. Thou art free! Walk in the joyous liberty of the Spirit today.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins.
Keep short accounts with thy God. His cleansing fountain is always open for the contrite and humble heart.
Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
Thy strength is found solely in thy union with Him. Clothe thyself in His divine power before thou enterest thy day.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son.
Ponder the depth of His sacrifice. Let such infinite love compel thee to live solely for His pleasure and glory.
Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
Live with expectancy. Our King returneth soon. Let thy lamp be trimmed and thy heart ready for His appearing.
The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
His goodness awaiteth the persistent soul. Seek Him with thy whole heart in every discipline thou undertakest today.
He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee.
The requirement is simple: Walk humbly, love mercy, and do justly as His faithful steward in this world.
Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them.
Let the Golden Rule govern thy day. Serve others as thou wouldst have the King of kings serve thee.
For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation.
Carry the Gospel with honour. Let its power transform thy habits and thy character before all men this day.
Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself.
Love is a discipline of the heart. Cultivate patience and kindness in every interaction thou hast today.
I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me.
Thine old self is gone. Let the life of Christ be the driving force behind every habit thou formest this hour.
Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
Submission is thy greatest weapon. When thou art yielden unto God, the enemy hath no power over thy walk.
But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people.
Thou art set apart for His glory. Walk with the dignity and the purpose of a child of the King today.
For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it.
Preparation is key to stewardship. Prepare thy heart to study and to live out His holy Truth in this day.
He delivereth and rescueth, and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth.
He is the God of miracles. Trust in His power to deliver thee from every trial and every lion\'s den today.
